integrity: The primary source was inspected for its random-radius definition, random-versus-optimal information framework, and ellipsoid application. The proof is reconstructed independently from rank-one compression and the beta law for Haar projections. Numerical checks in the bundled script are supplementary and are not used to infer the all-dimensional theorem.
scientific_limitations: The exact law is proved for centered one-spike Euclidean ellipsoids, whose quadratic form is a scalar matrix plus one rank-one perturbation. It does not give a closed joint spectral law for ellipsoids with several distinct semiaxis levels and does not improve general random-section inequalities.
title: Exact random-radius law for one-spike ellipsoids in every codimension
